name: Arkansas
notes: Arkansas supports digital ID through the Arkansas Mobile ID app, Google Wallet, and Samsung Wallet. Apple Wallet is not currently supported.

wallets.name: Google Wallet
steps: Open Google Wallet on your Android device.
Tap + and select 'ID documents', then 'Driver's license or state ID'.
Scan the front and back of your Arkansas driver's license or ID.
Complete the selfie step to verify your identity.
The Arkansas DFA will process and approve your digital ID within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Samsung Wallet
steps: Open Samsung Wallet on your Samsung device.
Scan the front and back of your Arkansas driver's license or ID.
The Arkansas DFA will verify and approve your digital ID.

wallets.name: Arkansas Mobile ID
steps: Download the Arkansas Mobile ID app from the App Store or Google Play.
Create or sign in to your Arkansas DFA account.
Follow the in-app prompts to scan the front and back of your Arkansas driver's license or ID.
Your Mobile ID will be available in the app once approved.
